C2a-R4 marked this LIVE through the generic armed branch of operator._play_fast_attack_recovery, which was too strong. That branch is only reached from _update_melee_attack when the fast-chain weapon is null or sets fast_chain_has_integrated_recovery = false, and both shipped melee weapons (sword_cleaver, vigil_pattern_dagger) set it true and author their own chain recovery. So no shipped loadout reaches this identity. The canonical art and the code path both remain; an armed melee weapon without integrated recovery would make it live again. Proven by operator_attack_phase_cadence, which asserts the integrated-recovery weapons complete a real fast attack without entering the generic recovery path.
